description: Executive assistant received spearphishing email with spoofed CEO domain prompting immediate login on fake Microsoft 365 credential harvesting page.
Marketing team member received unsolicited LinkedIn message containing malicious resume attachment with macro payload.
EDR detected LockBit 3.0 ransomware staging executable attempting to terminate backup agents and delete VSS shadow copies on production hosts.
Lateral movement attempt using PsExec across internal Active Directory domain controllers following credential compromise.
Public Amazon S3 storage bucket containing unencrypted customer transaction history databases readable anonymously from 0.0.0.0/0.
Public customer API gateway endpoint exposes verbose stack trace and internal database server IP addresses during HTTP 500 error responses.
Critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2024-7646) identified in active production Kubernetes ingress controller.
Production database bastion host runs OpenSSH 7.4 with deprecated Diffie-Hellman key exchange algorithm on internal management network.
Decommissioned internal mediawiki instance on isolated lab subnet 10.99.1.5 retains default admin password; contains no customer data and is inaccessible externally.
Developer local sandbox Docker daemon listening on 127.0.0.1 uses self-signed testing TLS certificates for offline integration tests.
Internal test staging database gateway responds to ICMP echo diagnostic requests inside private non-routed subnet.
